overview_description.description:
Genius is an online media platform that brings music intelligence to the masses.  Powered by its community, in-house creative team, and the artists themselves, Genius serves music knowledge to over 100 million people each month on Genius.com and everywhere music fans connect across the internet. 

Founded in 2009, Genius began as a platform for annotating rap lyrics. Over the years, it has expanded its mission to include more than hip-hop, and more than just lyrics. Every song has a story that needs to be told, and the biggest names in music—including Frank Ocean, Lorde, and Lin-Manuel Miranda—come to Genius to give the world insight into their art.

product.name: Genius
product.description: An online music knowledge platform providing licensed song lyrics, artist and album information, annotations, credits, metadata, charts, news, and community contributions.

product.name: Genius Original Series
product.description: Original video and editorial programming in which artists discuss the meaning, writing, production, and creative context of their songs.

product.name: Genius API
product.description: An API that enables developers to access Genius lyrics and music-knowledge data for applications, websites, and other digital integrations.

product.name: Promote Your Music
product.description: A promotional service that helps artists and music teams present releases and music-related content to Genius’s audience.

product.name: Advertising on Genius
product.description: Advertising placements and audience-targeting services for brands seeking to reach Genius users through digital music content.

product.name: Lyrics Licensing
product.description: Licensing services that authorize the display and use of Genius lyrics across its properties and supported integrations.
